jobDescription:
Frontend Developer (React) — Remote within EU

Our SaaS product serves clinics across Europe. The frontend is a large React application in TypeScript, and we hold a high bar on testing and accessibility because our users work under time pressure.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain features in React and TypeScript
- Style with Tailwind CSS following our design system
- Write unit tests with Vitest and end-to-end tests with Playwright for every feature you ship
- Meet WCAG 2.2 AA: keyboard navigation, focus management, screen reader labels
- Work with the design team on component API decisions

Requirements:
- Solid React and TypeScript
- Demonstrated experience writing automated tests as part of normal work, not as an afterthought
- Understanding of web accessibility in practice
- Comfortable in an English-speaking remote team

Nice to have: Storybook, design systems experience, performance profiling.
